manifest.author: Matthew James Davis
manifest.description: A practical operating system for Copilot Studio that gives agents a consistent way to clarify outcomes, choose the right approach, solve problems, make decisions, plan projects, improve processes, handle incidents, and turn repeatable work into reusable skills. Unlike a standard Copilot experience that relies mainly on the prompt and available context, Business OS adds a structured way of working…
